Chapter 1213 - 26: Lin Yuan And The Various Heavenly Venerates (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1213: Chapter 26: Lin Yuan and the Various Heavenly Venerates (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan, having evolved the Chaotic Taiji Dao, was very sure that his strength had completely surpassed that of a transcendent Great Saint.

Yet, whether he had reached the level of an Invincible Great Saint remained uncertain.

The gap between a transcendent Great Saint and an Invincible Great Saint was vast.

In those years, the Xuanhuang could easily drive the Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint, such transcendent Great Saints, to a dead end, finally forcing them to reincarnate.

Even among the six ancient countries of the Origin World, the strongest Venerables who were comparable to the Invincible Great Saints, such as the Fu Xu Venerate, were far superior to the topmost Peak Venerables.

Before the Fu Xu Venerate, Lin Yuan didn’t even have the chance to fight back, only passively enduring the blows, as the power and methods mastered by the opponent were far beyond what Lin Yuan could handle.

So now, Lin Yuan was very curious about his own strength. Was he close to being an Invincible Great Saint, or had he completely stepped into the realm of the Invincible Great Saint?

"Want to know how strong you are?"

The girl in red slightly twitched the corner of her mouth upon hearing this.

If she weren’t so clear about Lin Yuan’s character, and knowing this inheritor of the Infinite Void had just undergone a transformation, she would have doubted the truth of his words.

"Okay."

The girl in red nodded, then flipped her hand.

Instantly, the jade gourd trembled slightly, and a piece of Eternal Essence Gold, about hundreds of meters large, flew out, hovering in front of Lin Yuan.

"Penetrate this piece of Eternal Essence Gold, and you probably possess the strength of the fifth layer of the Infinite Void," the girl in red said.

The Infinite Void has seven layers in total, with the seventh being a theoretical level, while the fifth layer... Normally, cultivating the thirteenth-level legacy to the fifth layer would grant one the strength to traverse the Chaos Void and become an Invincible Great Saint.

As for the sixth layer? Few cultivators of the Infinite Void have reached the sixth layer.

"Penetrate?"

Lin Yuan looked at the Eternal Essence Gold in front of him.

The second layer threshold of the Infinite Void requires leaving a trace over ten centimeters deep on the Eternal Essence Gold.

But the fifth layer requires penetrating a piece of Eternal Essence Gold hundreds of meters large, a significant difference indeed.

Rustle.

The power of the inner universe circulated, with a magnificent black-and-white Tai Chi Diagram faintly appearing and disappearing.

The hundred-meter-large Eternal Essence Gold in front of Lin Yuan quickly twisted and disintegrated. Within a single breath, the entire piece of Eternal Essence Gold was pierced through, with the remaining parts continually collapsing.

"Such power?"

The girl in red took a deep breath. She almost didn’t feel any power fluctuations, yet the Eternal Essence Gold was pierced through, indicating a complete restraint of power.

This meant that Lin Yuan hadn’t used his full power.

Once he strikes with full force, it would be challenging to perfectly contain all the power.

"Your inner universe now has reached the level of the fifth layer of the Infinite Void, no, it’s approaching the sixth layer. Your strength has fully stepped into the realm of the Invincible Great Saint," the girl in red quickly said, while looking somewhat distressed at the pierced-through Eternal Essence Gold.

The Eternal Essence Gold, left by the creator of the Infinite Void, is limited, and usually, the girl in red would only take out a meter or two at most. If Lin Yuan’s strength weren’t so terrifying, she wouldn’t have brought out such a large piece.

"Invincible Great Saint?"

Lin Yuan steadied his mind.

At the same time, thinking of the Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master.

When his own homeland universe was so weak, he knew of these two absolute powerhouses, and now, he finally reached their level of strength.

Certainly, the Xuanhuang finally forcefully broke free from the time loop, surpassing the boundary of the twelfth level, no longer within the normal level range.

"What do you plan to do next?"

The girl in red retracted the Eternal Essence Gold, asked curiously.

"First, finish cultivating the third layer of the Infinite Void," Lin Yuan said. He had been cultivating the third layer for a long time, and evolving into the Chaotic Taiji Dao had led to a profound transformation of his inner universe, greatly advancing the cultivation of this thirteenth-level legacy.

"The third layer of the Infinite Void?"

The girl in red looked at Lin Yuan, suddenly realizing that this inheritor hadn’t yet finished the third layer of the Infinite Void.

Having such strength without completing the third layer, if he completes the third layer, how many layers will that compare to? The sixth layer?

...

After chatting with the girl in red for a few more sentences,

Lin Yuan began wholeheartedly cultivating the third layer of the Infinite Void.

The cultivation of this thirteenth-level legacy is essentially a micro physical restructuring and reorganization of the inner universe, which is much easier under the control of the Chaotic Taiji Dao.

Plus, Lin Yuan had already cultivated halfway through the third layer of the Infinite Void.

Therefore.

It only took one or two years.

The inner universe of Lin Yuan underwent another transformation.

On the infinite micro level, the structure of the inner universe was becoming perfectly complete.

"The third layer is completed..."

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, overlooking the vast inner universe.

Not to mention how stable the spacetime Dao rules of this universe were, simply its diameter size, having gone through two transformations, first evolving into the Chaotic Taiji Dao, and then completing the third layer of the Infinite Void.

Lin Yuan’s inner universe reached five hundred trillion light-years.

Five hundred trillion light-years, far surpassing the naturally born universe within the Chaos Void, even among transcendent Great Saints, having such a large inner universe is extremely rare.

This is still based on the premise that Lin Yuan’s inner universe isn’t specialized in size or area.

"I suppose my current strength could be considered strong among the Invincible Great Saints?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The Chaos Void is different from the Origin World, where the Invincible Great Saints are solitary, not easily comparable.

"Continue cultivating."

Lin Yuan took out the Second Layer weapon, the Sky Void Tripod, pondering the endless rules and great dao contained within it, while the cosmos within his flesh and Soul Body continued to elevate until it reached its growth limit.

At that time, it would be when Lin Yuan crosses into the Chaos Realm.

...

Fang Yuan World.

In the treasured land.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, feeling the explosive growth of his own strength.

By developing a path of Chaos Power, mastering the third layer of "Infinite Void," his true self’s inherent potential in this Fang Yuan World also experienced a significant enhancement.

"The spacetime suppression in this treasured land can no longer restrict me."

Lin Yuan observed the surrounding spacetime.

The newly emerged treasured land, connected to the Origin Source of Fang Yuan World, produces extremely strong spacetime suppression, which greatly reduces the range of investigation of Heavenly Venerate-level experts, and equally plummets the distance of spacetime traversal.

A peak Peak Venerable wishing to traverse the entire treasured land can’t rely solely on their own power; it would take considerable time, and only someone like Fu Xu Venerate, the Strongest Venerable, could traverse the treasured land in a single breath.

But now.

Lin Yuan had already realized that the spacetime suppression of this treasured land couldn’t contain him, meaning Lin Yuan could also traverse the entire treasured land in a single breath just like Fu Xu Venerate.

Even more swiftly.

"Fu Xu Venerate?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes narrowed slightly, looking towards a direction.

That was the location where the first giant core pillar emerged, and back then Lin Yuan was just beside it, having the earliest opportunity to refine the giant core pillar.

However, this opportunity was seized by the later arriving Fu Xu Venerate.

At that time, Lin Yuan had no ability to resist in front of Fu Xu Venerate and was directly slapped away.

...

In the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, an independent space.

"Everyone, next we must face the strong of other Ancient Countries to seize the core pillars head-on."

Red Flame Venerable spoke gravely.

Having been in the treasured land for over a thousand years, by now most of the unmastered core pillars have been refined by the strong of various Ancient Countries.

To continue refining more core pillars now, one must snatch those already refined pillars from other Ancient Countries.

"Okay."

"No problem."

"Chi Yan, who do you plan to strike first?"

The Peak Venerables nodded, they had long been prepared, entering the treasured land a thousand years ago? That was the warm-up, the mutual scrambles between Ancient Country powers were just superficial engagements.

In the five hundred years after the millennium, the intensity of scrambles would rapidly increase, and the last five hundred years would be the period of fiercest competition, during which all peak Peak Venerables would exert their full effort, and the heritage weapons of various Ancient Countries would be unleashed.

"Hmm."

Red Flame Venerable nodded, suddenly looking at Lin Yuan, softly inquiring, "Galaxy, what do you think?"

As one of the only four top Peak Venerables in this Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Red Flame Venerable regarded Galaxy Venerate with importance.

"What do you think?"

Lin Yuan was slightly taken aback, pondered, and then said, "Could we wait a while longer?"

"Wait a while longer?"

Red Flame Venerable was puzzled.

The other numerous Peak Venerables were also slightly surprised.

Why wait a while longer?

"I plan to..."

Lin Yuan grinned and said, "Take back that giant core pillar!"

...

Giant core pillar.

One by one, the Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country sat cross-legged.

The importance of the giant core pillar was too high, even though it had been refined by Fu Xu Venerate, other strong of Da Fu Ancient Country would also send a main battle physical body to guard at all times, to respond to any variables.

"Hahaha, in this competition for the treasured land, our Da Fu Ancient Country occupies seventy-two refined core pillars, plus this set of giant core pillars, making a total of eighty-two."

"Leading the second place Barbaric Wilderness Country by nearly thirty core pillars."

The many Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country were relaxed, now that their country had an absolute advantage, even if the two giant core pillars that emerge later fall into the hands of a single Ancient Country, the number of refined core pillars occupied couldn’t surpass Da Fu Ancient Country.

Moreover, the probability of the two giant core pillars falling into the hands of one Ancient Country is too low, even Da Fu Ancient Country wasn’t confident, let alone other Ancient Countries.

"Still relying on Fu Xu Venerate, if it weren’t for Fu Xu Venerate, this giant core pillar would have probably fallen into the hands of Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

"Indeed, that Galaxy Venerate of Fierce Sun Ancient Country sure was lucky, with the giant core pillar descending right next to him, if not for Fu Xu Venerate’s supreme strength..."

"Tsk, what good is luck? Didn’t Fu Xu Venerate still slap him away?"

The Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country casually conversed, as one of the oldest Ancient Countries, they had a subtle superiority when facing same-tier experts from other Ancient Countries, even when facing someone like Galaxy Venerate, the first to excavate ancestral bloodline to the Venerate level.

What is an ancestral bloodline at the Venerate level worth?

At this moment—

A young man appeared near this giant core pillar.

The young man had a faint black and white Taiji diagram mark on his forehead, the black and white aura swirling, appearing openly in the sight of all the stationed Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country.

He just stood there quietly, without any words or actions.

Yet it made many of the Peak Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country’s hearts tremble, regardless of strength, whether top Peak Venerables or ordinary ones, all felt their minds unsettled, feeling suffocated.
